description: Fetch a single commit by SHA: metadata plus the list of files it changed (path, status, additions, deletions). Mirrors GET /api/v2/repos/.../commits/:sha. Patch bodies are NOT included — use gluecron_get_diff for those.

include_files.description: Include the files-changed summary and stats (default true). Set false to skip the diff read on very large commits.

name: gluecron_get_commit
